records.name: Lava Bomb
records.description: Throw a bomb which triggers a fire explosion upon impact, deals damage and reduces armor.

records.name: Spirit Realm
records.description: Enter the realm of spirits and become unable to attack and immune to all damage.

records.name: Brute Force
records.description: Your attacks release your unstoppable might staggering your opponents. Your power attacks overwhelm your enemies, knocking them back.

records.name: Smoke Curtain
records.description: End all combat and become invisible for a short duration.

records.name: Arcane Exploit
records.description: Overflow yourself with power taking damage but boosting your magic resistance and outgoing spell damage.

records.name: Dark Arena
records.description: Create an impenetrable barrier around yourself. Inside the cage you deal more physical damage and receive less physical damage.

records.name: Grappling Hook
records.description: Throw a hook to your aimed target dealing physical damage and pulling it towards you.

records.name: Archaic Might
records.description: Unleashes a shockwave which does a massive amount of physical damage. Staggered enemies take additional damage.

records.name: Dragon Unrelenting Force
records.description: Staggers targets and knocks over loose objects.

records.name: Psionic Stinger
records.description: Drives an enemy up to a certain level mad for a short period of time.

records.name: Summon Apparition
records.description: Summons the apparition bound to your talisman. If it is already summoned it is instead unsummoned.

records.name: Tapestry of Souls
records.description: Allows you to see souls if the unlocked tier of Tapestry of Souls is high enough. Pay attention to the whispering noise to find them.

records.name: Transmute
records.description: Allows you to extract ectoplasm from killed undead enemies and soul stones from normal corpses.

records.name: Call Apparition
records.description: Teleports your currently summoned apparition to you.

records.name: Unleashed Fury
records.description: Inflicts entropy damage to enemies in front of you.

records.name: Transform Back
records.description: Transform back into a human form.

records.name: Portable Laboratory
records.description: Allows you to use a portable alchemy laboratory on your travels.

records.name: Call of the Hunt
records.description: Emit a terrifying howl which damages nearby enemies.

records.name: Detoxification
records.description: Unleashes all chymica in a deadly poison cloud

records.name: Switch Instinct
records.description: You activate or deactivate the memory "Instinct".

records.name: Colossus
records.description: For a short period of time you grow into a behemoth with increased resistances, Stamina and Health.

records.name: United Souls
records.description: Your apparition transforms into a werewolf for a limited amount of time.

records.name: Massaker
records.description: Absorbs Health with every hit in wolf form for a short period of time.

records.name: Ghostwalk
records.description: You teleport yourself forward unnoticed. You become invisble for a short period of time and have an increased critical hit chance.

records.name: Eye of the Storm
records.description: Your extraordinary focus allows you to perceive time differently for some seconds.

records.name: Devour Soul
records.description: Absorbs Health, on higher tiers also Mana and Stamina, from a fallen enemy.

records.name: Flash Powder
records.description: Blinds your enemies so you can hide again. Blinded enemies cannot be attacked.

records.name: Psionic Veil
records.description: Warps you in a spectral veil for a short period of time which makes you invisible.

records.name: Dimension Rift
records.description: Incapacitates an enemy for a short period of time, absorbs their Mana and Stamina in batches and deals them the total absorbed energy as damage when the effect ends.

records.name: Arctic Wind
records.description: Launches a cone of frost which freezes weaker or equal enemies. Frozen enemies may shatter.

records.name: Fire Breath
records.description: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as inferno.

records.name: Glacial Bomb
records.description: Throw a bomb which triggers an ice explosion upon impact, deals damage and freezes enemies that can be shattered.

records.name: Onslaught
records.description: Charge at your enemies, deal them a bit of damage and stagger them.

records.name: Meditation
records.description: Meditate to unlock new memories and thus make yourself stronger.

records.name: Shadowtongue Oil
records.description: Throw a bottle of Shadowtongue Oil which leaves behind a slippery oil puddle at the place the bottle hits.

records.name: Fire Arrow
records.description: Creates fire arrows in your quiver which can set your target on fire.

records.name: Frost Breath
records.description: Your breath is winter, you Thu'um a blizzard.

records.name: Skaraggian Stance
records.description: Increases damage and power of your blows and shield bashes, but also the damage you take yourself.

records.name: Qyranian Stance
records.description: Increases attack and movement speed but decreases blocking. Furthermore enemies have a higher critical hit chance.

records.name: Blade Dance
records.description: If you can land 5 hits within 15 seconds after using this talent, the last hit does massive damage.

records.name: Starling Dummy
records.description: Throw a mechanical spider which attracts enemies to itself, then explodes and makes them prone to damage.

records.name: Iron Maiden
records.description: For a short period of time all melee damage you take is thrown back to your enemies.

records.name: Rocksolid
records.description: For a short moment you hardly receive any damage.

records.name: Entropic Blood
records.description: Turns an enemy for a short period of time into your slave. Their damage is greatly raised and their death triggers an explosion.

records.name: Disarm
records.description: Shout defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.

records.name: Tempest
records.description: Increases your weapon damage for a short period of time.

records.name: Focus
records.description: Lowers the Mana costs of all spells for a short period of time.

records.name: Shadow of the Wind
records.description: You are moving much more silently for a short period of time and do additional damage with sneak attacks.

records.name: Unrelenting Force
records.description: Staggers targets and knocks over loose objects.

records.name: Well of Life
records.description: If you would die while this spell is in effect your Health will be restored instantly and enemies around you are pushed back.

records.name: Shock Nova
records.description: Unleashes a wave of electric energy around you that staggers your enemies and hits them with thunder shortly after.
